headline: Discovery call & outreach templates created: 5-part execution framework with email templates, call script, objection playbook, and tracker.

primary_stat.label: Production-ready templates
primary_stat.value: 5 parts (emails, script, playbook, tracker, synthesis guide)

highlights: 5 email outreach variants (warm-intro, peer referral, cold-to-warm, objection response, multi-stakeholder routing)
30–40 minute discovery call script with Van Westendorp pricing ladder (4 anchors: $2K, $4.8K, $24K, $36K)
Comprehensive tracker template (29 fields per prospect: WTP perceptions, objections, pilot intent, verbatim quotes)
Objection handling playbook for 4 top objections (vendor lock-in, brand fidelity, multi-brand support, procurement)
Post-call synthesis guide to aggregate WTP distribution and objection themes across 5+ calls
Pre-call preparation checklist and example completed tracker entry
